floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published one, two and three bedroom layouts for Tower A. The linked official booklet covers this tower. Match the unit reference and level on the complete plan; total areas include the listed balcony or terrace.
floorPlans.note: Plans and dimensions are approximate and may change. Different unit and level groups may share a plan code with different areas; sheet references keep these versions distinct. Furnishings and indicative views are not sale guarantees.

review.images: All5 exact page-gallery images visually reviewed. The native1923px building JPEG from own brochure physical5 was separately reviewed and selected for detail/card/hero; no decorative background image used.
review.location: Own official page pin and regional diagram reviewed; Creek Haven and Creek Bay share the same published reference coordinates. Visible scope identifies the shared point. Own brochure physical4 time panel visually reviewed; future Blue Line qualified.
review.floorPlans: All12 complete residence title/area panels visually reviewed, TowerA physical3–14. First numerical TOTAL AREA column is sqft; second is sqm. Decimal plan codes and repeated code versions preserved with sheet numbers. Original14pagePDF and unedited full sheets retained.
